Commentary.Commentary: Virat Kohli was a class above once again. On a pitch where the batsmen were struggling to get their bat on ball, he was middling it and scored at a pretty good rate too but unfortunately was dismissed when Stokes took a stunning catch. So England need 405 runs to win. It's going to be really difficult as the track has started to misbehave. Let's see how the visitors fight now. India will bank their bowlers to do the job. Join us back for the fourth innings.

Good comeback by England today to bowl out India in the extended first session! They picked up 7 wickets and it was started by Stuart Broad who dismissed Rahane and Ashwin in his superb 8-over spell. The rest of the batters couldn't make their mark and kept giving away their wickets. Rashid joined the party as well and picked up four wickets. Stuart Broad finished with four too. The last pair frustrated England though and took India's lead past 400.

OUT! The bowling change does the trick and Moeen strikes first ball! Bowls it flatter outside off, Shami comes forward and pushes at it but is beaten by the ball skidding through. Bairstow takes the bails off in a jiffy and makes a confident appeal. The umpire goes upstairs for the stumping appeal. The replays roll in and it looks like Shami's back foot is just planted on the crease. There is nothing in and  the TV umpire is satisfied with the replays and rules it out. INDIA ARE BOWLED OUT FOR  204!
Moeen Ali comes on to bowl.
FOUR! Fuller length ball outside off, Jayant strides forward and drives it uppishly through point for a superb boundary. Bisected the infield to perfection!
Four Byes! On a length this time outside off, keeps very low. Beats Yadav on the push and it goes right through Bairstow. Four byes signaled by the umpire. Lead swells to 400 now.
FOUR! These are handy runs for India! Strays this one on the pads, Yadav gets a tickle on it and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Fullish ball around off, pushed off the front foot to mid off.
On a length outside off, Jayant stays back and punches it to the covers.
Fullish delivery outside off, driven nicely through the covers. Declines the single again.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
SIX! SHOT! Loopy ball on middle, Shami takes a couple of steps down and tonks it over wide mid on. The ball clears the fence easily. They are nearing the 400-run lead.
This time he stays back and plays it towards point for a single.
Quicker one outside off, stays low. Yadav plays at it but misses.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.

Bowls a loopy ball on middle, turns away a bit. Yadav prods forward to defend but misses the line and is rapped lows on the pads. Loud appeal by Rashid but turned down. Rashid wants to take the review but Cook doesn't agree. The replays show that it would have missed the off stump. Good decision to not take the review.
On a length sprayed down the leg side, Shami looks to flick but misses.
Fullish and angling in on middle and leg, clipped through mid-wicket. The slight misfield by the fielder allows the single.
Fullish delivery wide outside off, inviting him for the drive. He goes for it and gets a thick edge down to third man. Doesn't take the run again.
Back of a length outside off, Yadav hangs back and pushes it to the off side.
Fuller length ball outside off, driven towards the man at sweeper cover. Doesn't take the single.
Full length ball outside off, Jayant lets it go. The ball died on the keeper that time.
Ben Stokes comes back to bowl.
Googly again, kept out watchfully.
Bowls a googly on a back of a length on the stumps, Shami camps back and looks to play it but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Tossed up on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler.
Tossed up outside off, Shami gets his front leg across and goes for the inside out shot but misses.
Quicker one, Shami stays back to defend.
Quicker one back of a length on the stumps, Shami goes back and punches it to the covers.
Lunch has been extended as India are 9 down. Play will go on for another half an hour.
Full toss outside off, Yadav drives it to the covers where Hameed dives to save runs.
FOUR! Classy stroke! Bowls it full on middle, Yadav clips it through mid-wicket with authority and the ball races to the fence. India lead by 384.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Fullish ball, shaping back in. Yadav comes forward and drives it to mid on.
On a length on the stumps, Shami defends it towards mid-wicket for a brisk single.
Fullish ball outside off, shapes back in. Shami goes for a drive but is beaten.
Yadav drives it with the spin to mid off.
Straighter one from Rashid, Yadav defends with his bat and pad together. A stifled appeal for LBW turned down.
Field change. Deep mid-wicket comes to mid-wicket and long on comes in.
Floated outside off, pushed to the covers.
Tossed up delivery, Shami goes back and punches it to long on for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Shortish outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a run.
Back of a length outside off, steered to third man for a single. A good dive from Duckett inside the circle but fails to restrict it.
On a length outside off, Jayant comes forward and drives it through the covers for a couple. The bat turned in his hand while he played that!
Fuller length ball outside off, shapes away this time. Yadav pushes inside the line but gets beaten.
Fullish and straying on the pads, Yadav looks to flick it but misses and is rapped on the pads.
On a length, shaping back a bit. Jayant stays back and pushes it to mid off.
On a length outside off, stays low. Yadav stays back and defends it.
Loopy on middle and leg, defended off the front foot down the pitch.

SIX! Brute power from Shami! Saw Shami coming down so Rashid drags his length back a bit. Shami absolutely thumps it over long on and the ball sails over the boundary ropes. What a shot that was, made a cracking sound of the bat!
On a length outside off, Shami stays back and defends it to the off side.
Fullish on the stumps, eased down to long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, spinning back in. Shami goes for the big heave but toe ends it onto his pads. The ball rolls to the leg side. Single taken!
Fullish delivery going down leg, Shami looks to work it through but misses.
Jayant Yadav is getting some treatment on his feet.
Fuller length ball outside off, defended off the front foot to the covers.
On a length outside off, gets a bit of extra bounce. Yadav fends it to the off side.
Fullish and wide outside off, Yadav first looks to play at it but pulls out at the last moment.
Fullish delivery, swinging back in. Yadav defends it off the inner half to mid on.
Similar length outside off, Yadav plays it towards point.
Back of a length delivery around off, Yadav stays back and looks to defend but  gets an inside edge onto his pads.
FOUR! Shortish delivery on the stumps, Shami goes back and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary. These are handy runs for India.
Shortish outside off, dabbed towards point.
The batsman has played it to the point region
Mohammed Shami is the last man in.

OUT! Rashid gets his fourth! Getting rewards for his probing lines and lengths! Bowls it slow through the air on middle and leg, Yadav with minimal foot movement looks to heave across the line but misses it completely. The ball spins and bounces away sharply to extract a faint edge towards the keeper, the ball hits Bairtsow's body first but he does well to grab it in the end. Superb work. India lead by 362!
Slips in a googly on middle, spinning down. Yadav looks to clip but misses and is hit on the pads. Loud shout for LBW by Ali but the umpire shakes his head. It would have probably gone down leg.
Tossed up on the stumps, defended with the inner half to short leg.
Classy bowling from Anderson! In the corridor of uncertainty, jagging back in. Yadav stays back and pushes at it but is beaten all ends up.
Good length ball outside off, Yadav reaches out to it and plays it with an angled bat to point.
Fullish delivery outside off, Jayant comes forward and defends it to the off side.
Fuller length ball on the stumps, driven a bit uppishly towards mid on.
Back of a length ball wide outside off, Jayant slashes at it hard but fails to connect.
On a length reversing back on off, Yadav comes forward and defends it down the track.
Floated on off, defended solidly off the front to the off side.
Umesh Yadav is the next man in.

OUT! Jadeja departs in the hunt for quick runs! Tossed up on the stumps, Jadeja kneels and goes for the slog sweep. Doesn't time it that well and hits it right down the throat of Moeen Ali at deep mid-wicket who gets underneath it and takes a simple catch. Rashid gets his third and he has bowled pretty well.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated on off, Ravindra puts a big stride forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Back of a length on the stmps, spinning down. Jadeja lets it go.
On a length on the stumps, keeps low. Jadeja is back to defend it to the leg side.
On a length outside off, Jayant stays back and defends it to cover-point.
On a length outside off, shaping away this time. Yadav draws forward and plays it with an angled blade to point. He looks pretty sound in technique.
Very full on middle, Jayant pushes it down the ground and it hits the stumps at the other end.
Strays on a leg stumpish line this time, Yadav comes forward and defends it to mid on.
Gets this to reverse back from a length, Ashwin comes forward and looks to clip but misses and is hit on the thigh pad. Good bowling by Jimmy.
Fuller length ball outside off, Jadeja strides forward and guides it through backward point for a single.
Jimmy Anderson comes into the attack.
Slips in a googly on middle, Jayant draws forward and defends it down the track.
Bowls it back of a length on middle and leg, spinning back in. Yadav camps back and defends solidly.
Slow through the air on off, Yadav looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Floated outside off, Jayant puts a big stride forward and drives it nicely through the covers. Sweeper cover cuts it off and keeps it down to two.
Full on middle, pushed to mid on off the front foot.
Slips in a googly on off, Jayant goes back and punches it to mid off.
Dug in short outside off, Jadeja has nothing to do with it.
In the corridor of uncertainty, nipping back sharply from there. Yadav looks to defend but gets an inside edge that goes through the slip region. Single taken!
Length delivery outside off, shaping away. Yadav camps back and defends it to the off side.
Filed change. Silly mid on and keeper and slip come up a bit.
Fullish delivery on middle and off, Yadav drives it uppishly towards mid on.

FOUR! Lucky for Yadav! On a length outside off at 145 clicks, angling in. Yadav stays back and there is nothing much he can do about it. He pushes at it but gets a thick outside edge that runs past Bairstow and through to the boundary. The pitch is becoming more and more difficult to bat on.
Leg bye! Fullish and straying on the pads, Jadeja misses his flick and the ball rolls square of the wicket off his pads. Leg bye signaled by the umpire.
Back of a length around off, Yadav camps back and defends.
Bowls it from the front of his hand on off, Jadeja prods forward and eases it to long off for a run.
Tossed up on middle, defended to the leg side.
Jadeja stays back this time and defends.
Shortish outside off, Yadav cuts it through cover-point for a single.
Jayant Yadav is the next man in.

OUT! How did Stokes catch that? Bowls it slower through the air outside off, spinning away. Kohli lunges forward and flashes at it hard but only manages to get a thick outside edge. It flies to the right of Stokes at first slip and he dives athletically to grab a stunner. It is a terrific reflex catch and the crowd goes silent! A superb knock from the skipper comes to an end and he misses out on a ton. India lead by 351 runs.
On a length on off, Jadeja hangs back and pushes it to the covers.
On a length and angling in from outside off, Jadeja covers his off pole and makes a watchful leave!
On a length wide outside off, keeps a bit low. Kohli goes back and plays it through point. Single taken!
Jadeja gets another warning for running on the danger area. He was warned earlier as well.
Comes around the wicket and bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Jadeja steers it through point for a single.
Kohli walks across to the length delivery and places it behind point for a single.
Fullish delivery on off, clipped towards mid on.
SIX! THAT'S CLOBBERED! Bowls a loopy ball on middle, turning away. Jadeja puts in a big stride forward and clears the long on fence with ease. Great timing on that one!
Jadeja looks to defend but only manages to get an inside edge onto his pads. Stifled appeal for LBW turned down!
Googly on middle, Jadeja looks to play it with soft hands but the ball bounces a bit more and he has to fend it to the off side.
Loopy ball on middle, Virat uses his wrists and clips it to mid on for a single.
Full on middle and leg, Kohli comes forward and defends nicely.
Tossed up on middle and off, eased down to long on for a single.

Virat Kohli is being attended by the physio as he had hurt his left hand. Meanwhile, Drinks has been taken. An eventful first hour of the Day as the pitch is misbehaving quite a lot now. Can India stretch their lead to 400 and the skipper reach his ton or will England restrict them as much as possible?
Length ball on off, Kohli covers the line and defends.
Length ball outside off, Jadeja gets an inside edge and the ball rolls to the fine leg region. Single taken.
Beaten! Good length ball outside off, Jadeja tries to push but gets beaten.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.

NOT OUT! Length ball around off, angling in, Kohli gets across a touch tries to clip it to the on side but misses and the ball goes off the pads to the leg side. There is an appeal for a leg before but the umpire says not out and signals a leg bye. England take a review and replays show the ball would have clipped the leg stump and that's umpire's call. Kohli survives this time.
England have taken a review as the umpire has turned down an LBW appeal.
FOUR! EDGED! Good length ball outside off, Kohli tries to push but gets an outside edge. The ball goes through the vacant slip region and runs past the fence.
Full ball on off, Jadeja lunges forward and defends it solidly.
On middle and off, Jadeja gets onto his front foot and defends.
Fullish outside off, driven through mid off by VK for a single.
Landed around off, Kohli covers the line and defends.

Landed around off, some bounce, Jadeja tries to play it off his back foot but gets a bottom edge towards fine leg. The batsmen go for the third and as Kohli tries to reach near the striker's end, his bat is stuck. He runs in and makes it in though. He looks in pain but he's alright.
Ravindra Jadeja is the next man in.

OUT! Umpire's call! It's a googly around off, Saha lunges forward to defend but misses the variation and gets hit on the pads. The umpire takes his time and raises his finger as England appeal for a leg before. Saha waits for a while and decides to take a review. Replays show the ball would have clipped the leg stump so that is umpire's call which is out. India are six down, lead by 330 runs.
Saha is given out. He has taken a review though.
Fullish ball outside off, Saha pierces it through the gap near point for a single.
In the corridor outside off, Saha gets onto his front foot and defends.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli leaves it alone. The ball stays really low and the keeper fumbles. The batsmen take a bye.
Landed outside off, Kohli covers the line and defends.
Good length ball on off, Saha flicks it through square leg for a single to get off the mark.
Wriddhiman Saha walks in next.

OUT! Broad picks up another wicket and this time no review by Ashwin! Fuller length ball outside off, angled in, Ashwin tries to defend but gets a faint edge to the keeper behind. The umpire raises his finger and Ashwin starts walking back. Broad picks up his fourth wicket, he has bowled really well here and he's not even hundred percent fit.
Landed around off, Kohli pushes it to covers.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
How did that miss the stump? Down the leg side, Ashwin tries to paddle but misses. The ball goes past the leg stump, misses it by a whisker.
Fullish ball outside off, Ashwin drives it to covers.

Chance of a run out! Fullish on off, Kohli taps it to covers and sets off. Ashwin responds but says no, Kohli screams loudly and asks him to run. The offie makes it in. Kohli was really angry out there. Single taken eventually.
Fullish and on the pads, Kohli tries to defend but gets hit on the pads. The umpire turns down the appeal as the ball would have probably gone down the leg side.

NOT OUT! Inside edge! Good length ball landed just outside off, Ashwin tries to defend but gets hit on the pads. Big appeal for a leg before and the umpire raises his finger. Ashwin takes a review straightaway. Replays show there is an inside edge and the umpire overturns his decision. Ashwin survives!
Ashwin is given out LBW! He has taken a review straightaway.
Length ball around off, stays low, Ashwin defends it off his back foot.
Shortish outside off, Kohli slashes at it. The ball goes off the outside half of the bat towards third man. Single taken.
Landed outside off, Kohli defends it off his front foot to the off side.
Length ball on off, angling in, Kohli tries to play it across but gets hit on the thigh pad.
Beaten! Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli gets onto his front foot and goes for the big booming drive through the off side but gets beaten completely.
Shortish outside off, Ashwin cuts it straight to backward point.

FOUR! Fullish on middle, Ashwin comes down the track and hits it down the ground. Rashid fails to stop the ball to his right and it races away to the fence for a boundary. Good shot, that. Was it a dropped though?
Shortish on middle and off, Kohli works it through square leg for a single.
On the pads, Ashwin flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Fullish on middle and off, Ashwin drives it back to the bowler.
Tossed up ball on off, Ashwin drives it towards mid off.
Adil Rashid to bowl now.
Landed outside off, Ashwin punches it through the cover region for a single to get off the mark.
Ravichandran Ashwin walks in next.

OUT! Edged and gone! It's a length ball outside off, a leg-cutter, Rahane pokes at it and gets a thick outside edge. The ball flies straight into the hands of Alastair Cook at first slip who makes no mistake. Stuart Broad takes his third wicket. Twin failure for Rahane in this Test match. India lead by 317 runs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Landed outside off, Kohli guides it to third man for a single.
Shortish outside off, Kohli blocks it out to the off side.
Back of a length ball outside off, Rahane plays it past point for a single.
Shortish around off, Kohli pushes it back to the bowler.
Banged in short on off, Kohli ducks under it.
Length ball on off, Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket.
Good length ball outside off, Rahane guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Rahane drives it straight to the short cover fielder.
Full ball on off, Rahane digs it out watchfully.
Fuller length ball outside off, stops a bit, Rahane drives it towards mid off.
Good length ball on off, Rahane gets onto his front foot and defends it away.
Full on the pads, Kohli flicks it through square leg for a single.
Landed outside off, touch fullish, Kohli pushes it towards point.
Landed just outside off, Kohli stays back in his crease and defends.
FOUR! Gorgeous! Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli leans onto it and drives it beautifully through the mid off region for a glorious boundary.

FIVE OVERTHROWS! Landed outside off, Kohli taps it to point and sets off for a quick single. Stokes comes charging in, collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The ball ricochets and goes to the fence as well.
Full on the pads, flicked away to long leg for another single.
Good length ball around off, Rahane pushes it back to the bowler.
Angles it on the pads, Kohli flicks it away towards long leg for a single.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli tries to push with a straight bat but gets a leading edge to mid off.

Fuller length ball on the pads, Rahane tries to flick it across but misses and the ball goes off the pads to the leg side. The umpire turns down the leg before appeal as the ball would have probably missed the leg stump. Leg bye taken.
James Anderson to bowl from the other end.
Full ball around off, Kohli digs it out. The ball goes off the pads as well and Broad appeals for a leg before as he thinks it's boot first but the umpire says not out.
Landed just outside off, Kohli defends it from within his crease.
Good length ball outside off, shapes away after landing, Kohli pulls out in time.
Landed around off, Kohli gets onto his front foot and defends.
Fuller length ball outside off, Kohli drives it through the cover region for a couple.
Starts off with a full ball outside off, Kohli digs it out. The ball goes towards gully.

Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane walk out to the crease. The Indian skipper is unbeaten on 56 and eyeing twin tons in this Test. Can he achieve that feat? Stuart Broad to bowl first up for England. Here we go!

Hello everyone to the coverage of day 4 of the second Test between India and England in Vizag. The hosts are firmly in control with a lead of 298 already and have lost just three wickets. They would look to bat more than one session and set a huge target for their visitors. Let's see how England fightback from this position.
...Day 4, Session 1...

So, with the lead almost 300, the pitch starting to misbehave, the Indians will fancy their chances to take a 1-0 lead to Mohali. However, you never know if the tourists put up a fight like they did in the first Test, this game can head either way. How much will Kohli and co. feel is enough to hand over the willow again to the opposition? Join us tomorrow at 0930 IST to see how the penultimate day unfolds. Till then, you can switch tabs to the on-going match of the tri-series where Zimbabwe have done reasonably well with the bat against the West Indies. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

England were eventually bundled out for 255 and handed a massive 200-run lead. The visitors did well to jolt the home side early as both the openers were sent back cheaply. Anderson then removed Pujara through a peach of a delivery but that was all for them today. Kohli and Rahane then kept the English bowlers at bay and made sure they avoid further hiccups. The skipper has got to his fifty and Rahane would be itching to be amongst the runs tomorrow and will be relived as he was dropped early by Bairstow.

Another fabulous day for India! They didn't start off the day well as in the morning Bairstow and Stokes frustrated them for almost the entire session and stitched a crucial 110-run stand. However, after lunch the hosts came out all guns blazing and it was Ravichandran Ashwin who tormented the English lower order by getting his 22nd 5-wicket haul in Tests.
Bowls it short on middle, Rahane stays back and defends it. That's STUMPS, DAY 3! India lead by 298 runs.
Flatter outside off, Rahane keeps it out towards covers.
Kohli goes back and works it towards mid-wicket from his crease for a single.
FOUR! Nicely done! Shorter on middle, keeps low, Kohli goes back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Kohli adjusted to the bounce superbly.
Outside off, no shot offered.
Floated outside off, Rahane comes forward and defends it towards square leg off the inside half of the bat for a single. That kept low!

Slight confusion! Fuller outside off, Kohli plays it back down the wicket. Stokes looks to field and throw but ends up parrying it towards mid on. Kohli and Rahane are not sure whether to go for the single or not. They end up not taking it. Rahane then signals that he is not able to spot the ball clearly.
Length ball outside off, no shot offered by Kohli.
Kohli gets across and defends it towards the on side.
WIDE! Short and spraying it down the leg side, Kohli is happy to let it go. It is a wide since it was way down the leg side.
Back of a length on off, Rahane gets across and taps it towards fine leg for a single.
Bangs it short on middle, Rahane is caught in a tangle but lets it go behind him.
50-run stand up between Virat and Rahane!
Shorter outside off, Kohli pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Loopy ball around middle and off, Jinx buries it into the ground.
Prods forward and keeps it out on the off side.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
13th Test fifty for Virat Kohli!

FIFTY! Tossed up outside off, Kohli comes forward and drills it through covers for a single. His love affair continues at this very ground. Phenomenal performance once again as he gets another half century under his belt.
Drops it short on middle, comes up at a nice height too. Rahane pulls it through mid-wicket but once again will have to settle for a single.
Tossed up around off, pushed towards covers.
On a length and around off, Jinx taps it towards the off side and scurries across for a quick single.
On a length and outside off, Rahane punches it hard but goes straight to Joe Root at point.
Back of a length outside off, Rahane doesn't fiddle with it.
Touch short on middle and leg, Kohli swivels and pulls it through backward square leg to get to the other end.
Back of a length delivery on middle, rises off the deck as Kohli does well to fend it away on the leg side.
Sprays it down the leg side, Kohli won't even look at it.
Ben Stokes is brought into the attack!
Gets deep in the crease and flicks it through mid-wicket to keep strike.
Gets on the front foot and blocks it out.
Loopy ball around off, VK makes a watchful leave.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Flatter through the air around off, Kohli leaves it alone. Bairstow looks to collect but the ball pops out of his gloves.
Tossed up ball around off, Kohli defends it down.
Another one staying low as AR blocks it out gently.
Sees the drift, gets back in the crease and defends.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Around middle and off, Ajinkya shows a straight bat.
Short and around off, turning in and staying low too. Rahane looks to punch it off the back foot but gets a bottom edge.
Tossed up ball around off, Jinx keeps it out towards covers.
A long hop offered by Rashid and he is lucky to get away with it. Rahane gets back and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket. There is Ansari stationed there and they will get only one.
Flattish on middle and leg, clipped behind square on the leg side for another single.
VK defends it from within the crease.
Gets forward and defends it into the ground.
Around middle, turning away, Kohli goes back to play at it but is beaten all ends up.
Drops it short on middle, it stays very low and Kohli gets really low to put this away towards mid-wicket for a couple.
Comes down the track and whips it through mid on for a single.
Floated ball around off, VK punches it back to Ali.
Short and outside off, Rahane camps back and punches it through covers for one.
Gets back and tucks it through the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball around off, Kohli makes a long stride forward and drives it through covers and comes back for a couple.
Around middle and off, defended by covering the line of the delivery.
Gets right behind the line of the delivery and blocks.

Drift, turn and bounce! Really well bowled! Bowls a loopy ball around off, turns away after pitching as Rahane comes forward to defend. Is beaten by the away turn as the ball whizzes past the outside edge and into the keeper's gloves.
Full and around middle, Jinx defends it in front of short leg.
Around middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Very full on off, Ajinkya plunges forward and blocks it out.

That's played really fine! Flatter ball around middle and leg, Kohli gets back in the crease and tickles it off his pads towards fine leg. Stokes gives it a chase and does really well to scoop the ball back in play. Three runs taken.
Around middle and off, Jinx prods forward in defense.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Floated ball around off, Kohli pushes it towards point for a single.

Loopy ball around off, Rahane looks to drive it through the off side but gets it off the outer part of the bat through backward point. Ansari comes across to his left from the deep and keeps them down to three.
Drops it short and outside off, Rahane makes room and punches it straight to extra cover.
Tossed up ball around off, Rahane comes forward and defends it towards covers.
MOEEN ALI is the new bowler for England.
Kohli is now allowed to have drinks. The umpire, Rod Tucker has a chat with James Anderson.
Comes a bit forward and defends it down watchfully.
Loopy ball around middle, turning away, Kohli punches it down to mid on.
Lunges forward and pushes it towards the off side.
Tossed up delivery around off, driven straight to cover.
Flatter one around off, pushed towards point,
Tossed up ball around middle and leg, Kohli looks to flick but misses and it hits him on the pads and then rolls on the off side.

Things getting heated up in between. Anderson was seen having a word with Kohli. Something happened between the two. Kohli asks for some refreshment but the square leg umpire comes to him and informs him that he can't get drinks right now.
Good length delivery on off, Virat opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single to keep strike.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Kohli hops and fends it on the off side.
Strays it on the pads, tucked towards fine leg for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Elegant! Fuller in length, Anderson rolls his fingers on the ball and serves it on off. Rahane leans into it and drives it on the up through covers. Through the gap and away she goes for a boundary.
Gets across and flicks it through mid-wicket for an easy single.
Tossed up around off, defended off the front foot.
Around off, stays low again but Rahane does well to defend it down.
Quicker through the air around leg, it's nudged through mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up around leg, Kohli comes forward to defend but is hit on the pads.
On middle and leg, worked behind square on the leg side for a couple.
Loopy delivery around off, Kohli drills it through covers for a couple.

FOUR! Every ball misbehaved in this over! Some stayed low, some bounced. The batting is going to get tougher. Back of a length ball on off, Rahane gets back and punches it through point for a boundary.
On a length and around off, Rahane defends.
Fuller on off, pushed towards covers.
Short of a length ball on off, Rahane looks to cut but gets a bottom edge to that one.
On a good length and around off, pushed with soft hands towards point.
Back of a length delivery on middle and off, defended from within the crease.
Another one staying low. Around off, VK crouches and somehow manages to defend it down.
Jinx eases it through wide mid off for a single.
Comes down the track and defends.

Edged and dropped! Loopy ball around off, drifting through the surface. Rahane plunges forward to defend but gets a thick outside edge that hits Bairstow's pads and rolls on the off side. Chance goes down abegging.

Short ball on middle, it stays really, really, really low. My colleague sitting next to me says, only the Indian batsman could have played this. Kohli camps back and pulls it through square leg and scampers across for a single. He then turns back for another but seeing a throw being made at the keeper's end, he sends Rahane back. Luckily, Ajinkya didn't come halfway down the track. One run taken.
Flatter through the air around middle, it's punched back to the bowler.
Drinks!
Outside off on a length, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Rahane is happy to defends this one from his crease.

Too full outside off, Rahane comes forward and creams it towards mid off. Ansari stationed there dives to his right and stops the ball. Parries it towards the fielder coming in from mid on. No run taken though. Ansari seems to have hurt his finger there.
Angled on a fuller length on off, comes in a touch, Rahane covers the line and defends it.
Good length outside off, left alone by Rahane.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and drives it towards wide mide off for a single.
Shorter length on middle, Kohli controls his pull and gets it down to fine leg for a single.
Angled on middle, Rahane comes across and clips it through mid-wicket. Cook ambles after it as the batsmen come back for the third run.
Rahane again covers the line and defends it.
Good length outside off, Rahane comes forward and defends it.
Good length on the pads, Kohli tucks it through square leg for a single.

FOUR! Sublime! Fuller on off, Kohli just slams it down the ground past mid on. The ball raced away to the fence. Stokes is shaking his head in disbelief. That was elegantly hit by Virat Kohli, sheer brilliance.
Fuller on middle, Rahane covers the  swing and clips it towards mid on.
Ajinkya Rahane is the next man in, replacing Pujara!

OUT! TIMBER! Anderson bowls it outside off on a length, gets it to nip in after pitching, Pujara plays down the wrong line and is beaten. There is a huge gap between the bat and pad and the ball sneaks through it to hit the top of middle stump. Anderson has made an impact and Pujara has to go back. India lead by 240 runs.
Fuller outside off, Pujara pushes it towards covers where Ali dives and stops the ball. That prevents the single.
Back of a length outside off, defended back down the wicket by Pujara.
Fuller outside off, pushed towards covers by Pujara.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it towards square leg off the inner half for a single.
Back of a length outside off, placed towards Duckett at backward point from his crease.
Hurled on a length, clipped through backward square leg for a single.
Angled on a length outside off, Kohli gets across and clips it towards mid-wicket.

FOUR! Streaky! Good length outside off, this one keeps low, Kohli still manages to get some bat on it, he opens the face and gets it through gully for a boundary. That came off the bottom half of the bat.
Kohli walks across to work it through mid-wicket but gets it back down the wicket off the outer half of the bat.
FOUR! Total control! Fuller outside off, Kohli presents the full face of the bat and pushes it down the ground. The ball races past the mid off fielder for a boundary. That raced away to the fence.
A touch short one outside off, Pujara looks to cut that one at first but then lets it go through.
Fuller outside off, another no shot offered.
Length outside off, no shot offered by Pujara.
Fuller on middle, Pujara looks to clip but gets a leading edge towards mid on from his crease.
Bowls it outside off, Pujara comes forward and pushes it towards point from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Pujara comes forward and pushes it to covers.
JAMES ANDERSON into the attack.
A touch short on middle, Kohli rides the bounce and defends it.
Played towards point for a run.
Flicks this one through the leg side for a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends it.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Bowls it outside off, on a length, played towards covers by Kohli.
BEN STOKES is the new bowler.
Fuller on middle and leg, Pujara looks to clip but it hits on his pads. Mild appeal again from Broad which is turned down.
Good length outside off, Pujara punches it towards mid on from his crease.
Fuller outside off, Pujara unfurls a cover drive but straight to Stokes at covers.
Back of a length outside off, comes in, Pujara takes the bottom hand off the bat and defends it towards short leg.
Pujara strides forward and defends it towards covers.
Fuller outside off, comes in, left alone by Pujara.
FOUR! Kohli is not letting England get away here! Floated outside off, Kohli gets on top of it and crashes it through point for a boundary.
On off and middle, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Stays back to this one and keeps it out. That one kept low.
Kohli comes forward and drives it to covers.
Floated on middle, Kohli comes forward to defend but is hit on his front pad.
Flatter on the pads, tucked through backward square leg for a single. Leg bye signaled.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Outside off on a fuller length, Kohli strides forward and drives it through wide mid off for a boundary. That is really well timed.
Fuller outside off, Kohli comes forward and defends it.
Off the mark! On a length on middle, Kohli clips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, comes in a long way, Kohli is confident though and he leaves it.
Angled on a length on off, Kohli pushes it towards the on side.
VIRAT KOHLI is the new man in, under pressure at the moment.

OUT! BROAD STRIKES AGAIN! Bowls it outside off, KL Rahul comes forward to defend but is beaten all ends up as the ball goes past the outside edge. The keeper and the skipper put their hands up but are not sure. Broad is not sure as well but then contemplates a review. Hameed from short leg signals to Cook that there was a faint edge. Stokes comes in from covers and also gives his approval. They go for the review. The replays confirm there was an edge there and another decision has to be overturned. Broad strikes twice and both the openers are back in the hut.
Is there an feather behind? Broad is not confident but the young Hameed at short leg did hear something and asks his skipper to take the review. Let's wait and see...
Shorter outside off, Pujara places it towards point off his crease.
Floated outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it off inner half of the bat.
Flatter on middle, KL Rahul goes back and punches it towards mid off for a single. The mid off is a bit deep inviting the big shot.
Outside off, Rahul comes forward and defends it.
Bowls the leg spinner on middle, bounces a touch, KL Rahul defends it coming forward.
KL Rahul comes down the wicket and taps it back down the wicket.
Good length outside off, Pujara punches it towards point off his crease. A wicket maiden from Broad. He has figures of 4-4-0-1!
Angled on a length on off, turned towards mid-wicket.
Fuller outside off, Pujara comes forward and defends it towards covers.
CHETESHWAR PUJARA walks in to bat.

OUT! Good review by England! Bowls it outside off, comes in with the angle, Vijay looks to defend from his crease but gets an inside edge onto his pads as he is beaten by the inward movement. The ball lobs up towards Joe Root at gully who dives forward to take the catch. Broad celebrates but cannot believe it is not given out. England go for the review. Replays confirm the edge and the catch is clean as well. Vijay has to go. Twin failures for him. India lead by 216 runs!
Broad is confident as always and takes the review against Vijay. Root was claiming the catch at second slip.
Good length outside off, Vijay comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
Good length outside off, Vijay comes forward and pushes it towards covers.
FOUR! Paddled! KL Rahul gets in line and paddles it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. That was nicely done by Rahul.
This one is on the pads, does not get up at all. Rahul is lucky as it was on the pads.
Bowls the leggie on middle, turns away, KL Rahul covers the line and defends it.
Pushes it to covers from his crease.
Fuller on middle, Rahul comes forward and turns it towards mid-wicket.
FOUR! NICELY DONE! Floated outside off, KL Rahul goes back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary. He waited for it and placed it well. The point fielder jumped for some reason.
ADIL RASHID has a change of ends.
Full outside off, left alone.
Shorter length outside off, this one bounces normally and Vijay lets it go over him.
Bowls it outside off, keeps very low, Vijay can do nothing about it. The ball almost goes through the keeper and nearly hits the rested helmet.
Shorter length on middle, Vijay sits and lets it go over him.
Angles it on middle, Vijay looks to clip it through but gets a leading edge towards covers.
Fuller outside off, keeps a touch low, Vijay comes forward and defends it.
Welcome back for the final session of play. MURALI VIJAY and KL RAHUL are out to bat. ENGLAND begin the final session with STUART BROAD...
DAY 3... SESSION 3....

Tea will taste sweet to the Indians as they have managed to drag this session their way after a tough one in the morning. Ravinchandran Ashwin ran through the English tail, registering yet another 5-fer and was given good support from others. They got a huge lead of 200 runs and have dealt with the available 8 overs. The pitch is misbehaving, the odd ball is staying low and these are the signs of it crumbling as the game progresses. Can England chip in with quick wickets to get back into this game or will the Indian openers make the visitors toil under the sun? Stay tuned for the final session.
Loopy delivery around off, Rahul comes forward and defends it down watchfully. THAT IS TEA ON DAY 3!
Makes room and bunts it back to the leggie.
Pushes it quicker through the air around off, turning away further, Rahul is happy to let it go.
A loud appeal for LBW! Floated ball around off, Rahul makes a long stride forward to defend but gets a thick inside edge on the pads. A loud appeal has been made but the umpire turns it down.
Tossed up around off, Rahul comes forward and defends.
Short and outside off, Vijay gets back and punches it through covers for a single
Adil Rashid comes on to bowl as still there are a couple of minutes to go for tea...
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On a length and outside off, KL pushes it towards point with an angled bat.
Good length ball on off, Rahul defends it off the front foot.
Full and on the pads, worked behind square on the leg side for a single.
Murali defends it from within the crease.
Right on the money is Anderson. Fuller on off, Vijay looks to defend but it hits the toe end of the bat and dies down.
Length ball, coming in with the angle, Rahul keeps it out on the off side.
Good length delivery on off, Rahul shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller and hurled in the channel on off, driven straight to the man at mid off.
Fuller and angling in, KL Rahul blocks it out.
Stays right behind the line of the delivery and offers a straight bat.
Good length delivery on off, stays low again but Rahul defends it down nicely.
In the corridor on off, MV has got nothing to do with that one.
Outside off, Vijay leaves it alone.
On a length and nipping back in from outside off. Vijay looks to defend but misses as the ball goes off the pads towards the keeper. An appeal is made but it is turned down.
Defended off the front foot gently.

KL Rahil is off the mark! On a length and outside off, Rahul punches it off the back foot towards covers and sets off for a single. Is sent back immediately by Vijay but a throw made at the striker's end is missed and they take a single now.
Pitches it up on off, Rahul looks to drive but gets it off the outer part towards backward point where Duckett puts in a dive to his right to stop that.
Fullish in length and outside off, defended down gently.
Another one staying low and outside off, Vijay looks to defend but is undone by the lack of bounce.
Strays it down the leg side, MV looks to clip it on its way down the leg side but misses and Bairstow collects the ball by moving swiftly to his right.
In the channel outside off, Murali lifts his bat and lets it go through to the keeper.
Fuller in length and once again stays low as well, Vijay stays back in defense.
Fuller and angling in, Vijay gets across and works it towards short mid-wicket.
STUART BROAD to bowl from the other end.
Fuller in length and around off, KL Rahul defends it with the full face of the bat.
Stays low! Fuller in length and outside off, doesn't rise as Rahul defends it awkwardly towards the off side.
Outside off, Rahul comes forward and defends it.
Good length on off, Rahul tucks it towards the on side.
Back of a length on off, Vijay takes his bottom hand off the bat and tucks it towards square leg for a single.
FOUR LEG BYES! Starts with a length ball on the pads, Vijay fails to clip it but the ball runs down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Byes signaled.
